analysis:
Both supplied units are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (base lines 2614-3280). They contain historical release notes for v0.8.x and v0.5.0 and no executable code. The PR patch for this file is documentation-only: it replaces the v0.10.4 candidate heading with a v0.10.5 candidate section and adds upgrade and rollout notes. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the added head text beyond the first rollout bullets was not visible to me.

The visible patch text mentions MLX pin bumps, the Metal backend (including kernels/fence.metal), SSD checkpoint namespaces bound to the binary and metallib hash, and the `darkbloom sandbox` CLI running the add-on installer from api-sandbox.darkbloom.dev/install.sh. These are descriptions only, not code changes in this batch. Their security relevance sits with T-041 (SSD prefix cache, whose at-rest posture the visible text leaves unchanged) and T-061/TB-013 (installer and add-on execution as the Mac's owner). Those controls would need review in the actual source files, which are not supplied here.

The base excerpt does not alter any control or trust assumption, and I identified no security regression from the documentation text. Open questions for integration: whether the truncated head text makes any claim, for example on installer integrity or on the cache TTL, that contradicts the threat model. The underlying code changes (the pin bumps, the sandbox CLI and the metallib change) were not part of the supplied evidence.
